# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Late teens to early twenties
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Iron-rank Essener / Magic Academy Student
- **Origin:** Vane Family
- **Role:** Essence user and academy student

## Appearance

Rufus is a handsome young man with athletic proportions and a disciplined, noble posture. He has light-colored hair and refined facial features indicative of his highborn lineage. His attire typically consists of high-quality combat gear or formal academy uniforms.

## Personality

Rufus is duty-bound, honorable, and fiercely dedicated to honing his skills as an Essence user. He holds high standards for himself and those around him, valuing hard work and martial excellence over mere status. Despite his privileged background, he shows genuine respect to capable allies regardless of their origin, though he can be overly strict and rigid in his expectations.

## Traits

- Honorable
- Disciplined
- Diligently devoted to martial mastery
- Proud of his family legacy

## Abilities

- Expert swordsmanship
- Sword-based Essence abilities
- High tactical and combat proficiency

## Goals

- Master his combat style and reach high Essence ranks
- Uphold the honor and legacy of the Vane family name

## History

Rufus Vane comes from a prominent family of combatants and trains rigorously to live up to his family's legacy. He encounters Jason Asano early in Jason's journey in Greenstone, serving as both an instructor figure and a dependable ally as Jason learns the fundamentals of Essence abilities and combat. Rufus works alongside Gary Ubik and Farrah Huron, forming a tight-knit and experienced team of Iron-rank essence users. Together, they assist in navigating local crises and monster outbreaks around Greenstone. Over time, Rufus develops a deep mutual respect for Jason, recognizing his unconventional methods and rapid growth despite their contrasting backgrounds.

## Background by volume

- Hails from the prestigious Vane family, renowned for their martial combat traditions
- Trained under rigorous family instruction before attending formal academies

## Affiliations

- Vane Family — Scion
- Adventure Society — Iron-rank Adventurer
